findings.text: Default virtualization hooks for page table lifecycle do nothing except report success for top level reservation. Allocation and release notifications for intermediate levels, clone notification, and top level free notification have no observable effect in these fragments.
Top level reservation size depends on processor isolation support. When the isolation capability is active the order is one, otherwise it is zero, so isolation doubles the reservation.

Helpers that link a lower table into its parent first issue a virtualization allocation notice for the child frame and then install the parent entry marked as a table. Kernel and process variants differ only in how the child frame number is derived, and the two top levels skip installation when five level paging is disabled.

Safe parent entry installers check the existing slot before writing. When the slot already holds a present entry that differs from the incoming value, a one time warning is raised, then the new value is installed unconditionally.

Deferred table freeing is split into thin wrappers and out of line workers. Wrappers forward to workers, workers issue a virtualization release notice for the frame and then queue the descriptor for batched reclaim. The fourth level wrapper is inactive unless five level paging is enabled, and the second level worker additionally forces a full flush on address extension builds.

Two level paging represents every table value and protection value as a single machine word. A page table entry is a union offering two equivalent word views, one generic and one explicitly low, reflecting that only one word is stored.

Two level geometry uses a directory shift of twenty two with one thousand twenty four top entries and one thousand twenty four entries per leaf table, while the middle level holds a single entry. The kernel portion starts at the index derived from the configured direct map base shifted by the directory shift, and table synchronization tracks middle level modification.

Three level paging represents every table value and protection value as a sixty four bit quantity. Page table and middle table entries are unions exposing either a sixty four bit view or a pair of machine word halves, allowing split access on thirty two bit builds.

Three level geometry uses a directory shift of thirty with four top entries, a middle shift of twenty one with five hundred twelve middle and five hundred twelve leaf entries, and supports up to thirty six bits of physical address. Kernel top entries start at the direct map base shifted by the directory shift, and synchronization tracks middle level modification.

Two level native accessors use plain stores for installation, zeroing for clearing, and atomic exchange for read and clear of leaf and middle entries. Upper level clearing and upper level installation for the folded level are empty, atomic variants exist for single processor builds, and a small bit field helper extracts a masked field and repositions it.

Three level native accessors preserve atomicity of sixty four bit entries on thirty two bit builds. Leaf installation writes the high half before the low half with an ordering barrier between, clearing writes the low half first with a barrier, and atomic installation plus read and clear use a compare exchange retry loop. Middle installation always uses that loop, upper clearing is empty, and single processor aliases replace the generic read and clear forms.

Middle entry replacement optimizes the case where the incoming entry is not present by exchanging only the low half and then updating the high half with ordered accesses, returning the prior value assembled from both halves. When the incoming entry is present it falls back to a full sixty four bit exchange.

Isolation aware top level installation propagates kernel side changes to the paired user table only when the slot lies below the kernel boundary and the entry is not marked to skip shadowing. The user copy receives the full value, while the kernel copy gains a no execute marking when it describes present user memory and the processor supports that marking. Outside isolation builds or when the capability is off, installation is an identity pass through, and user table address derivation sets a dedicated switch bit.

Swap entries encode a five bit type plus an offset. Two level layout places type bits above the present position and offset above the protection none position, with direct conversion between entry and swap value. Three level layout packs type in the low bits of the swap value and stores an inverted offset plus high placed type in the hardware word, with helpers translating in both directions. Both levels alias the exclusive marker to the large page bit, cap the file count to the five bit range, and two level entries never require value inversion.

Precise event configuration reserves bit seven as the enable indicator and bit eight as the micro operation tag indicator. The metric field occupies the low six bits and the overall configuration field occupies the low eight bits.

Global precise event control uses two distinct enable encodings, one for general precise sampling and one for tagged micro operation sampling, corresponding to the twenty fifth and twenty fourth bit positions in a sixty four bit control word.

Configuration decoding masks the incoming value to isolate the metric subfield and the wider configuration subfield, and presence testing checks whether any requested configuration bits survive that masking. The metric taxonomy distinguishes an empty value, cache and translation lookaside miss retire variants, branch mispredict, replay and split access retire variants, closed by an upper bound sentinel.

The event table associates each countable behavior with one or more mask selectors and a small numeric mask code. Coverage spans queue occupancy, SIMD and floating point operation widths, cache and buffer activity, front end and execution bogus accounting, retire and replay accounting, branch outcomes, assists, and machine clear causes, with codes clustered in the low range.

Overwriting a present parent slot with a differing value indicates unexpected mutation and triggers a warning path. Split sixty four bit updates without barriers or atomic exchange can expose torn entries to concurrent walkers, and middle table changes on address extension builds require a full translation flush.

Paging headers use include guards to ensure single inclusion and advertise native support for single page table allocation and top level freeing. Malformed entries at each level are reported through diagnostic helpers that log the file, line, and offending value.

Public page table construction entry points link child tables into parents and queue freed tables for batched reclaim. Callers provide the address space, parent slot, and child location, and the helpers handle virtualization notices, table marking, and level gating.

Native table accessors for installation, clearing, atomic read and clear, and middle entry replacement are provided for direct use by generic paging code, with build specific aliases selecting the appropriate read and clear implementation.
